title: Propose or decide a Todo desired-state design
summary: Create, correct, inspect, accept, or reject a desired-state design for a todo whose latest situation assessment is ready.
use_when: An established todo has a latest current ready `aN` and needs a normative desired-state reconciliation.
A ready, rejected, or abandoned design needs provenance-bearing correction or explicit decision.
do_not_use_when: The current situation is unknown, stale, inconclusive, or still needs a material user choice.
The requested artifact is a task list, sequence, estimate, file edit, command, deployment, or implementation record.
The owning umbrella is completed, superseded, or otherwise not open and canonical.
outcome: One basis-complete `dN` proposal or durable return for more assessment, followed only when explicitly requested by a deterministic provenance-bearing accept or reject decision.
effects: Propose and correct submit constrained Nucleus jobs and may consume Codex allowance.
A proposal records desired ownership, boundaries, state, interfaces, lifecycle, failure, compatibility, acceptance, non-goals, and jurisdiction transitions against one exact assessment.
Correction preserves the named predecessor and feedback and creates a successor rather than editing history.
Accept/reject bypasses Nucleus and records an explicit decision with readable UTF-8 provenance.
authority: Todo owns assessment selection, design grammar, basis validation, draft lifecycle, decisions, currentness, and domain success.
The liaison may propose or return for assessment but cannot accept, reject, plan, or execute implementation.
success: A ready design has no active choices, includes all nine clause kinds, covers every direction boundary, and covers every active predecessor operation.
Correction creates a traceable successor and leaves the predecessor unchanged.
Acceptance succeeds only while the exact assessment and umbrella bases remain current and stores the decision-source path.
failure_and_recovery: When evidence is insufficient or stale, the liaison records a durable assessment return instead of inventing desired state.
A run ending with an open draft marks it abandoned; inspect and correct it explicitly rather than treating it as ready.
A newer assessment blocks acceptance and correction against the older basis; reassess and reconcile again.
privacy: Designs and assessments may contain detailed current state, ownership, constraints, and desired interfaces.
Nucleus output retains model-side source and proposal traffic; decision sources are stored by canonical path in Todo.
does_not_authorize: Implementation planning, task creation, file edits, deployment, or execution.
Design acceptance based on model prose or job completion.
Using a stale assessment or changing external-system ownership without explicit accepted desired state.
